details: AAA-quality outdoor terrain plot built with Roblox native terrain voxels. 240x240 stud footprint centered at origin. Features: broad asymmetric hill (peak ~30 studs, offset to x=25 z=-20), natural grass/dirt/rock material layering, subtle sand erosion in low areas (8% of surface), height range 6-30 studs. Voxel-based terrain using WriteVoxels at 4-stud resolution. No buildings, forest, or bunker - just the terrain foundation. Please review: terrain geometry quality, material distribution, slope transitions, edge variation, collision suitability, and any technical issues.
